name: Slither Slide
summary: A multi-room snake game with a procedural closed B-spline body.
description:
Slither Slide is a multi-room snake and caterpillar cartridge and the runner-up in RIVES Jam #3. Choose a character, collect every item in a room and pass through the doors that open. The snake uses a procedural closed cubic B-spline body. Technical View exposes the control polygon, selected span and renderer samples without changing gameplay.

Controls:
- Up/Down or D-pad: choose a character
- Z/A1 or E/START: begin
- Arrow keys or D-pad: move
- D or R1: toggle Technical View
- A/F or L2/R2: select the previous/next B-spline span
